scope: Shared core and authentication preparation within original UI-COMP-001..004 and UI-SUPP-012. No GUI/routes/console/page restoration in this batch. Cancelled MGMT remains cancelled.

staging.source_status: This contract's public declarations/semantics are immutable for this batch; delivered source remains unverified until root unified typecheck and targeted tests pass.

rules: CORE consumes the session and fixture APIs described below, not their implementation bodies. AUTH consumes unscoped requestJson/ApiError/readSafeConfig described below, not their bodies.

The counterpart's write paths must not appear in context_files or be read by an absolute path, alias, live checkout, file search, tool, sibling temporary copy or old snapshot. This is a deliberate opaque API dependency, not removal of a needed implementation hash.

Existing read-only test setup and imports may refer to opaque modules; their API calls are defined here. Author code/test source against this normative contract without resolving or executing hidden bodies.

If a task actually needs a counterpart implementation detail not specified here, stop that portion, report the missing contract or body dependency, and have root convert the dependent work to a serial request. Do not guess internals or bypass write/context protection.

Neither developer executes shell commands or module loads. Root runs unified commands against both actual deliveries, so cross-implementation contract integration is checked rather than claimed in advance.
No change to counterpart/shared files, production stub/shim copy, dependency upgrade or module alias to imitate the hidden implementation.

session_api.auth_owner_internal_export: __setSessionValidationStatus(epoch:number,status:SessionValidationStatus):boolean; only AUTH's validated probe/retry path may write it. Do not re-export the setter from @/auth or use it from feature/GUI code.
semantics: getSessionSnapshot identity is stable until a token transition. It lazily restores the existing localStorage key only; unavailable storage falls back to memory. Initial restored nonnull token has validation status pending.

The two-argument/default setSessionToken behavior remains proven/verified for nonnull explicit tokens, as used by successful login and existing tests. Null token is anonymous. An optional requiresValidation:true marks a restored/replacement token pending.

Each setSessionToken call retains the legacy epoch advance and cleanup-on-transition behavior, even for explicit repeated calls; persist defaults true. publish both current snapshots before invoking cleanups, then notify listeners. A rejected stale invalidateSession must not advance the epoch.

All registered cleanups are invoked on each token transition; one cleanup exception does not prevent others. Unregister is idempotent. This is the guarantee CORE uses to abort in-flight requests and invalidate channel scopes.
invalidateSession only clears a still-present token for the exact captured epoch, at most once for concurrent failures. No stale response may erase a newer login.

syncSessionFromStorage reacts only to the existing auth key or clear event and the actual localStorage area. Read latest storage instead of event.newValue; unrelated/read-failed events preserve memory. Genuine nonnull replacement uses pending validation; clear sets anonymous.

getSessionValidationSnapshot and its subscribe function are separate, stable useSyncExternalStore-compatible APIs. No token, raw config, password or source metadata appears there. Identity changes only for the current epoch or actual status change.

Successful validation updates pending to verified without incrementing sessionEpoch or running session cleanups. Transient failure becomes unavailable without clearing token. Stale epoch updates return false and do nothing; anonymous is valid only for null token.
Explicit retry goes from unavailable to pending for the same epoch, creates a new attempt generation and cannot revive previous-session work.
Session state never imports CORE/client/config/fixture bodies; only AuthProvider owns probe execution. This avoids circular client->session->client initialization.

public_exports: ApiError extends Error; constructor(status:number,payload:unknown,message?:string); public status:number,payload:unknown; name='ApiError'
unscoped_semantics_for_auth: Unscoped existing call signatures/behavior remain unchanged. AUTH calls auth/login and readSafeConfig without mode scope; these functions do not import channel/routing/GUI state from AUTH.

requestJson sends only explicit body/query fields to the injected same-origin service root. JSON gets Content-Type application/json; FormData keeps browser boundary. Scope is never serialized. No automatic mode field or extra request.

GET config/get?include_secrets=false and POST auth/login use the caller's exact options. Login excludes current bearer; other requests use current nonnull session token. cache:no-store, redirect:error and credentials:same-origin remain.

AbortSignal and session-epoch fencing are checked before send, after headers and after response body; ignored network abort cannot yield stale data. Network errors remain transport errors; explicit cancellation/staleness is AbortError.
No automatic retry, including writes. HTTP2xx body is returned for endpoint-specific semantic normalization; no universal success=true assumption.
Errors carry structured payload only when JSON is parseable; non-JSON payload is null. Public error message never includes raw payload, HTML, token or server detail.

Only HTTP401/403 with a plain object whose sole key is detail and whose exact value is one of the four approved local strings invalidates session: 密码错误, Not authenticated, Invalid authentication credentials, panel_authentication_required. Preserve first three; fourth is demonstrated by the current quota-summary missing-bearer dependency.

An auth/login failure never invalidates the current existing session. Business/upstream401/403, extra provenance/filename/error fields, arbitrary detail or any200 never log out. AUTH can rely on central invalidation for exact panel proof and must not broadly clear token in its catch.

Root/prefix containment, invalid metadata rejection and exactly-once path encoding stay equivalent to the existing implementation. Paths remain relative to the service root, not /ui or production origin.
scoped_semantics: Optional scope is PanelScope from domain/panel. Require current mode/channelEpoch/sessionEpoch before transport and after headers/body, register scoped channel cleanup in addition to session cleanup, and remove subscriptions after completion.
If explicit query.mode, JSON body.mode or FormData mode is present and mismatches scope.mode, reject before sending. Do not invent the correct endpoint mode position or silently rewrite the input.
Channel change abort/fence only scoped requests; unscoped shared settings/auth/log API calls retain their session behavior.

semantics: Perform exactly GET config/get with query {include_secrets:false} and optional signal using unscoped requestJson. Never omit false, auto-fallback to true or use /management/v1.

Validate the successful safe response envelope; config must not contain any of the three password keys, the configured flags must be booleans and capability/env lock values must be arrays of strings. Do not coerce malformed values into authenticated success.

Unsafe/malformed successful response throws a fixed safe ApiError with status200 and null payload, without echoing or retaining rejected values. Transport/API errors preserve ApiError/AbortError provenance for the caller.
Do not import settings/types or any feature body. No plaintext read helper or production stub. Return a projected safe envelope; AuthProvider consumes validity only and discards the data.
Network/proxy field values are ordinary safe configuration under this existing endpoint, but neither this module nor AuthProvider persists/logs them or caches the response globally.
Keep current registration order, first response other than404 wins; unregister removes exactly that handler and is idempotent.
Preserve current explicit DEV model-routing lazy adapter and auth/login synthetic response. Do not eagerly import page bodies or add model/credential fixtures.

Add GET config/get with an explicit include_secrets=false safe synthetic response matching SafeConfigResponse. It contains only invented ordinary config values/example.invalid URLs and configured booleans, with none of the three password keys.

Absent/true include_secrets must not produce plaintext or pretend a reveal succeeded; it remains an unsupported fixture request unless a later designated fixture explicitly handles it. No real backend fallback.
Unknown/unhandled fixture route returns fixed501 synthetic_fixture_not_registered. AbortSignal is checked before and after async handlers. CORE also applies session/scope fencing.
Production or fixture-disabled request transport never enters fixtureFetch; CORE keeps its existing DEV-and-flag gate.

narrow_internal_exports: __commitPanelChannel(mode:PanelMode):void; only future guarded route commit and module tests may call
__invalidatePanelChannel():void; only session cleanup/future coordinator disposal and module tests may call
semantics: React-free; no routing/provider/page imports or credential caches. Default modeAG, channelEpoch0; snapshot identity changes only on actual mode commit or invalidation. Store only harmless enum/epoch in memory, no new browser-storage key.
Identity is collision-safe JSON tuple serialization [mode,filename], retaining Unicode/percent characters without path encoding. Namespaced identity is not a source of credentials.

Internal commit of a different valid mode increments channelEpoch exactly once, invokes scoped cleanup before publishing the new snapshot and notifies listeners; no-op mode does nothing. Invalid mode is rejected.

Internal invalidation increments epoch and clears scoped work without resetting harmless selected mode. Integrate once with opaque registerSessionCleanup; avoid duplicate registrations or test-isolation leaks.
capturePanelScope copies current mode/channel epoch plus caller session epoch; isPanelScopeCurrent compares all three with current snapshot/session epoch. No token in scope.

Feature code cannot invoke unguarded setters through UI controls. No channels/routes/GUI implementation here; their later accepted implementation alone calls __commitPanelChannel after all route guards approve.

CredentialChange is metadata only: copy/whitelist mode, epoch and deduplicated basename-like filenames, bound5000, no objects/raw error/token/code/authURL/File/credentials. Drop stale-session or invalid events, isolate listener exceptions, retain no event history and support cleanup/unsubscribe.
The registry contracts enable later import producer/credentials observer without either worker reading the other's body; they do not implement a batch engine or job persistence.

Use session and separate validation snapshots. authenticated means nonnull token plus current-epoch verified validation. Current App already gates business pages on authenticated, so pending/unavailable cache restores cannot mount active page effects. GUI status/route changes are deferred to later serial batch.

Restored cache and genuine cross-tab replacement require safe prevalidation. Exactly one active probe for the current epoch/attempt, including StrictMode mount/unmount/remount; direct successful login/default explicit setSessionToken is proven and does not add a redundant config request.

Use opaque readSafeConfig(signal) once for validation; do not reconstruct/stub it, inspect unsafe legacy fields, store a config payload or add a second fetch. Successful shape validation marks the matching epoch verified without epoch advance.

Exact central panel auth invalidation removes the token. Other401/403/network/5xx or malformed success becomes unavailable and leaves token persisted; no broad catch logout or false verified state. retryValidation allows an explicit new same-epoch probe.

Abort/fence on logout/token replacement/unmount and generation changes; late success/error cannot authenticate/erase a newer session. If StrictMode dedup needs a shared in-flight probe, retain only transient promise/controller/epoch metadata, dispose result and safely abort real final unmount.
Keep existing latest-login attempt protection, logout cleanup, failed login behavior, memory storage fallback and delayed cross-tab event handling.
Do not alter GUI/LoginScreen/App/routes/channels/console, page source, dependency/style or test setup. Return validation fields so later GUI/console can consume the accepted real interface.
Frontend tests must exercise real combined shared client/safe config behavior when root runs them; tests may inject/mock transport timing but production must not contain mock aliases or stubs.

acceptance.combined: After both official deliveries root runs npm run typecheck then targeted npm run test -- src/domain/panel.test.ts src/app/client.test.ts src/api/config.test.ts src/auth/AuthProvider.test.tsx src/app/fixture-routing.test.ts. No developer shell execution.
must_cover: Two-field session snapshot compatibility; token-free stable validation snapshot; default explicit setSessionToken proof; pending restore/cross-tab; exactly-one current StrictMode probe; direct-login no extra request; stale and transient outcome handling.
Safe config false query/poison/malformed errors; metadata/prefix/filename handling; exact local auth versus upstream business401/403 including fourth one-field missing-bearer shape.
Scoped channel/session/header/body races, mode mismatch before network, no automatic writes/retry, cleanup idempotence.
Fixture registration/model-routing preservation, safe config false only, no plaintext reveal fixture and no production/live fallback.
Opaque contracts actual exported signatures, no counterpart context/read bypass, only each owner's6 allowed files changed.
acceptance.remaining: GUI/routes/channels/console bind only after real accepted exports are read serially. Native64-item restoration, fullfrontend tests/build/six-chunk checks, real integration and P3 remain pending.
